APARTAMENT 1+1 NE SHITJE KOPSHTI ZOOLOGJIK
Apartament 1+1 ne shitje prane kopshtit zoologjik ne residencen Salillari.
Prona ka nje siperfaqe prej 92.52 meter totale dhe neto 78.95 meter. Eshte i organizuar ne nje korridor shperndares, tualetin e dites ,dhome gjumi dhe hollin mjaft te gjere. Ka orientim lindje, ndodhet ne katin e dyte banim.
Ndodhet ne nje zone mjaft te preferuar per banim ,te qete si dhe me cdo facilitet brenda kompleksit.
Per nje vizite ne prone apo me teper informacion ju ftojme te na kontaktoni.
description_en: 1+1 APARTMENT FOR SALE NEAR THE ZOO 1+1 apartment for sale near the zoo in the Salillari residence. The property has a surface area of ​​92.52 meters total and 78.95 meters net. It is organized in a distribution corridor, day toilet, bedroom and quite wide hall. It has an east orientation, it is located on the second residential floor. It is located in a very preferred residential area, quiet as well as with every facility within the complex. For a visit to the property or more information, we invite you to contact us.
